            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        return c

        s = 0
        for n in route:
            s += demands[n]
        return s

        seen = set()
        for r in routes_list:

                if n not in customers_all:

                seen.add(n)
        return len(seen) == len(customers_all)

                b = best_route[i + 1]

                    if delta < 0:

                        best_route = new_route
                        best_cost += delta
                        improved = True
                        return best_route, improved
            return best_route, improved
